title: The Blue Blanket
description: A large, textured blue blanket lies crumpled and draped across a rocky, undulating landscape under a dark, stormy sky filled with swirling clouds. The fabric appears heavy and woven with intricate patterns, pooling in folds with visible stitching and texture across the terrain.
prompt: A massive textured blue blanket made of heavy woven fabric lies draped and crumpled over a surreal rocky landscape at night, its folds and stitching creating organic patterns across the terrain, dramatic swirling clouds fill the dark blue sky above, intricate detailed surface textures, moody and atmospheric, in the style of a classical surreal oil painting
